title: How to Handle Inaccessible Boot Device Error in Windows? - GeeksforGeeks
content:
The working mechanism & smoothness of every Operating System including Windows, depends upon the Installation of the the Latest Update. However, with this approach, you can get some Serious Errors on Windows.

Often, after successfully Downloading Update on Windows, the device failed to restart. And on the Windows Screen, you might see the Error Code 0x0000007b. This is because of the Inaccessible Boot Device Error in Windows.

This article intends to focus on the solutions to eliminate Windows Inaccessible Boot Device Error Code 0x0000007b.

Table of Content

  • What is Windows Inaccessible Boot Device Error & Its Different Causes?
  • How to Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error in Windows?
  • Method 1: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Removing Pending Update Packages
  • Method 2: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Enable AHCI on BIOS
  • Method 3: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Updating System Drivers
  • Method 4: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Fixing Corrupted Drivers
  • Method 5: Resolve the Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Resetting the PC
  • Method 6: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Removing Virus & Malware
  • Method 7: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Uninstalling Latest Application

What is Windows Inaccessible Boot Device Error & Its Different Causes?

In the Windows Operating System, the update is automatically downloaded on the device when any update is rolled out. Upon successful downloading the Update, it starts the installation process. And to Install Latest Windows Update, there is a need to restart the device.

Often, the device can't properly restart & you get the Issue Code 0x0000007b on the screen. This is because the Windows OS can't access the Boot Device to install the updates properly.

Reasons Behind Windows Inaccessible Boot Device Error:

  • Corrupted Hard Driver Issue on System.
  • Faulty Downloading of Windows Update.
  • Outdated System Software.
  • Problem in BIOS Settings.
  • Conflicting Latest Installed Application.

How to Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error in Windows?

To Fix the Inaccessible Boot Device Error on Windows, the following guidelines should properly be used in the series that is mentioned. Let us start with the very simple Windows Update Deleting Process.

Method 1: Resolve the Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Removing Pending Update Packages

Step 1: Search for the Command Prompt on the Search Bar & go with the option.

Step 2: Now, on the CMD, execute the following command. It will help to Uninstall Windows Update.

Command: wusa /uninstall /KB:<Conflicting Update Number>

Step 3: Click on the YES to complete the process.

Method 2: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Enable AHCI on BIOS

Step 1: Enter the BIOS Settings while Restarting the device by pressing the F2 Key multiple times. Now, go to Boot Time Screen under Advanced Tab.

Step 2: After that, press Enter there & select the Enable button.

Method 3: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Updating System Drivers

Step 1: Right-click on the Start Symbol & go to the Device Manager option.

Step 2: After that, click on the Update Driver option.

Step 3: Now, select the option Search Automatically For Drivers to get the latest driver.

Method 4: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Fixing Corrupted Drivers

Step 1: In this case also, search for the Command Prompt or CMD in the Search Bar.

Step 2: Execute the following command. It will check the health of the Hard Drives & fix them if any problem is there.

Command: chkdsk C: /f

Method 5: Resolve the Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Resetting the PC

Step 1: Open the Windows Settings & go to the Update & Security option.

Step 2: After that, click on the Get Started Option under Reset PC.

Step 3: Now, click on the Keep My Files option to Reset Windows without removing files.

Method 6: Resolve Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Removing Virus & Malware

Step 1: Open the Update & Security Settings on the Windows.

Step 2: Click on the Virus & Threat Protection option.

Step 3: After that, click on the Quick Scan to get viruses & malware on the device and fix them.

Method 7: Resolve the Inaccessible Boot Device Error by Uninstalling the Latest Application

Step 1: Search for the Add or Remove Program option on Windows Search.

Step 2: After that, find out the latest installed app name & click on it. Now, go for the Uninstall Buttons to complete the process.

So, these are a few simple methods to address How to Fix a guideline in an inaccessible guidelines Boot Device Windows Error. All the possible methods to address the Error Code 0x0000007b on Windows without taking the help of any technician are discussed here. However, if the Inaccessible Boot Device Error persists, you have to take the help of any technician as it is a really serious problem.
